slice.target: Cargo package.build semantics for a dependency package without links
slice.finding: The official Cargo manifest reference defines build as a field of the package's own [package] section. It states that build=false disables automatic detection of that package's build script. On this inspected surface, Cargo does not document a dependency-table or config.toml consumer override that sets another dependency package's package.build field.
slice.bounded_conclusion: For the exact tested case—a dependency package lacking links, with its upstream package manifest left unchanged—the inspected package.build documentation does not establish a consumer-side mechanism that suppresses that dependency's build.rs. This is a scoped unresolved blocker, not a claim that no Cargo mechanism exists anywhere.
slice.verified_scope: Official current Cargo manifest-format documentation for the [package].build field only; consumer depends on a package that lacks links and does not modify or replace that dependency's source manifest.
slice.not_verified_scope: [patch], [replace], source replacement, vendoring, alternate registries, path dependency substitution, wrapper/toolchain interception, custom Cargo builds, packages declaring links, actual Cargo execution, build-script semantic side effects, or end-to-end richer-mode parity.
slice.prior_own_state_context: worker_revision 429 had already verified the distinct links-declaring-package build-script override path. This slice does not broaden that prior result to packages without links.

scope_guard: Do not convert absence of a consumer override on the inspected package.build documentation surface into a universal impossibility claim for all Cargo mechanisms.

frontier.current_target: Determine whether a consumer-controlled Cargo dependency substitution mechanism can replace a no-links dependency with an equivalent package whose build script is disabled, without hosted compute, finite quota, or user execution.
frontier.next_unit: After fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only freshness validation, inspect exactly one official Cargo documentation section for [patch] dependency overrides. Determine only whether a consumer can substitute a dependency package source in a way that could carry package.build=false without editing the original upstream package; classify any residual source-preparation or execution requirement and do not run Cargo.

exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and freeze current authority, then inspect exactly one official Cargo documentation section describing [patch] dependency overrides. Determine only whether consumer-side package substitution can supply an alternate package manifest with build=false for a dependency that lacks links, without editing the original upstream source; record exact scope, zero-cost/quota status, and residual execution/source-preparation requirements, and do not attempt actual Cargo execution.
